ui.help.topics.inventory.title: Inventory
ui.help.topics.inventory.step_1: Record each device or service as an asset. Its permanent identifier never changes; the quick code makes it easier to find.
ui.help.topics.inventory.step_2: Open the record to check its data, attachments and history. Use filters to narrow the results; reset them to return to the full list.
ui.help.topics.inventory.step_3: Archiving keeps the record. Permanent deletion depends on the server policy and requires confirmation.
ui.help.topics.operations.title: Everyday operations
ui.help.topics.operations.step_1: Set up sites, locations and people before assigning devices. An inventory person is not an access account.
ui.help.topics.operations.step_2: From the record, assign an owner, record a return or move the asset. Check the destination before saving.
ui.help.topics.operations.step_3: Link virtual machines to their hosts and devices to their infrastructure. A relationship describes a dependency; it does not run remote actions.
ui.help.topics.incidents.title: Incidents and maintenance
ui.help.topics.incidents.step_1: Record an incident with the affected asset and a concrete description. Update its status while you investigate.
ui.help.topics.incidents.step_2: A maintenance plan schedules expected work; an intervention records the work done and its result.
ui.help.topics.incidents.step_3: Check the asset record to keep the context. Resolving an incident does not mean telemetry has recovered.
ui.help.topics.monitoring.title: Dashboard and monitoring
ui.help.topics.monitoring.step_1: The dashboard summarises operations. Customise the widgets to prioritise what you need and check the selected period.
ui.help.topics.monitoring.step_2: Monitoring reads the server integrations. No samples means there are no measurements, not that the device is up or down.
ui.help.topics.monitoring.step_3: An alert, an incident and a maintenance task are different records: check the source and the asset before acting.
ui.help.topics.warranties.title: Warranties and documents
ui.help.topics.warranties.step_1: Record the individual coverage from the asset and attach its receipt. Check the dates and the provider.
ui.help.topics.warranties.step_2: Check upcoming expiries in the warranty centre. The filters and the warning window decide which records you see.
ui.help.topics.warranties.step_3: Unlinking a receipt does not delete the asset attachment.
ui.help.topics.reports.title: Reports, labels and exchange
ui.help.topics.reports.step_1: Build the report with the assets and fields you need. Check the preview before printing or sharing.
ui.help.topics.reports.step_2: Labels help you find an asset record; they do not replace access controls.
ui.help.topics.reports.step_3: Data lets you import and export. Review import conflicts before approving them: changing the resolution invalidates the previous approval.
ui.help.topics.settings.title: Settings and identity
ui.help.topics.settings.step_1: Available options depend on your permissions. If an action is missing, ask whoever administers the installation.
ui.help.topics.settings.step_2: The visible name is edited in Settings → Appearance, in the «Application display name» field. Appearance controls presentation; it does not change data.
ui.help.topics.settings.step_3: The product has no final name yet. You do not need to replace the current identity to start using it.
ui.help.topics.agents.title: Agents
ui.help.topics.agents.step_1: Explain what you need and select an asset when the question depends on its record. Check the answers before making decisions.
ui.help.topics.agents.step_2: The agent uses server tools it is authorized to use. It gains no extra permissions by talking to you.
ui.help.topics.agents.step_3: Availability depends on the provider configuration and quotas. Do not share passwords or keys in the chat; human approvals remain human.
ui.help.topics.extensions.title: Extensions
ui.help.topics.extensions.step_1: An extension adds functionality. Check its origin, permissions and version before authorizing installation.
ui.help.topics.extensions.step_2: Native extensions are trusted code: they are not isolated like a hostile application. Their interface does not replace server authorization.
ui.help.topics.extensions.step_3: Deactivating an extension removes its interface contributions. Keep a backup and check compatibility before updating or restoring a version.
